stories.title: Practice-branded safe entry and patient eligibility shell
stories.acceptance: Resolve one practice, support established/new adult entry, collect location, run emergency-first triage, and expose non-clinical administrative gates.

stories.title: Queue, matching, consultation and video product path
stories.acceptance: Implement fair queueing, realtime status, clinician eligibility, atomic reservation, chart context, private video and complete encounter behavior.

stories.title: Pharmacy, claims, audit, kill switches and marketplace seam
stories.acceptance: Preserve pharmacy choice, claim-ready output, AVS, complete audit, scoped disablement, vendor-neutral adapters and future marketplace isolation.

stories.title: Workforce and patient resource authorization
stories.acceptance: Enforce identity, practice/facility/purpose, patient/request relationships and separated administrative, clinical, billing and support views.

stories.title: Break-glass, service identity and stale authority controls
stories.acceptance: Govern exceptional access, adapter identities, delegation, server authority, resume and patient cancellation without privilege expansion.

stories.title: Recoverable journeys and accurate actor-facing state
stories.acceptance: Keep failed work owned/recoverable, prioritize deterioration, carry accommodations, expose accurate status and protect support/integration semantics.

stories.title: Versioned request state and safe invalidation
stories.acceptance: Expose machine state/actions/blockers/version, enforce idempotent transitions, separate domains, preserve ready time and invalidate affected evidence.

stories.title: Readiness, appointment, queue and reservation transactions
stories.acceptance: Enforce freshness, atomic promotion/appointment/queueing, leased reservation, reasoned terminal actions and emergency terminality.

stories.title: Consultation closure, immutable history and recovery ownership
stories.acceptance: Require interrupted-visit disposition, append-only events, versioned client reconciliation, accountable recovery and safe kill-switch drain.

stories.title: Separated consumer, applicant, patient and enrollment identities
stories.acceptance: Model identity stages, minimize data, distinguish contact verification from proofing and implement approved NIST-aligned assurance and step-up.

stories.title: Duplicate-safe linkage and atomic promotion
stories.acceptance: Require independent linkage evidence, hide match candidates, atomically link/create/enroll/queue, fail conflicts closed and preserve change provenance.

stories.title: Identity abuse, evidence and lifecycle controls
stories.acceptance: Test identity attacks, restrict evidence, revoke on lifecycle changes, govern manual review and expire abandoned applicant records safely.

stories.title: Emergency-first deterministic evaluator
stories.acceptance: Evaluate universal emergency rules first, make unknown unsafe, prohibit opaque AI and publish only approved immutable protocol versions.

stories.title: Reproducible assessment and clinician-only review
stories.acceptance: Retain exact evidence, deny admin changes, require qualified reasoned review and record direct emergency communication without false dispatch claims.

stories.title: Freshness, exam sufficiency, monitoring and localization
stories.acceptance: Expire changed assessments, enforce remote-exam needs, preserve physician redirection and monitor safety/disparity with governed translations.

stories.title: Patient-location jurisdiction and clinician authority
stories.acceptance: Use attested/reconfirmed location, effective authority, deny unknown rules and enforce approved Georgia and California controls.

stories.title: Florida, prescribing, service and consent controls
stories.acceptance: Enforce Florida authority/disclosures, controlled-drug and excluded-service blocks, versioned consent and practice control of medicine.

stories.title: Regulatory monitoring, retention and state expansion
stories.acceptance: Operate source review, longest-rule retention, deny-by-default state expansion and historical policy/license/consent reconstruction.

stories.title: Verified practice branding and governed configuration
stories.acceptance: Bind host/origin, constrain branding, publish typed approved configuration, reject unsafe combinations and revalidate admin authorization server-side.

stories.title: Fair atomic clinician queue and patient status
stories.acceptance: Match deterministically, preserve FIFO/clinical reason, provide honest approximate status with realtime fallback and configured capacity/hours.

stories.title: Delay communication, monitored exceptions and isolation
stories.acceptance: Prevent endless waits, govern contact, review queue exceptions/bias, exercise kill switches and prove cross-practice isolation.

stories.title: Separate eligibility and exact network evidence
stories.acceptance: Model 270/271 semantics, exact product/entity/service network check, reject weak proof, require patient confirmation and version coverage.

stories.title: Fresh evidence, estimates and governed financial routes
stories.acceptance: Make evidence reproducible/expiring, structure manual proof, provide estimate/GFE, require explicit self-pay and scope payer rules.

stories.title: Coverage privacy, resilience and changed-state handling
stories.acceptance: Protect identifiers, handle vendor failure, disclose directory limits, preserve acknowledgments and re-evaluate in-queue financial changes.

stories.title: Purpose-limited clinical context and safe consultation start
stories.acceptance: Authorize chart context, require start checks, support safe redirect, prevent false template assertions and complete signed dispositions.

stories.title: Interrupted care, coding, follow-up and AVS
stories.acceptance: Close interrupted visits, govern coding, own orders/referrals, deliver accessible AVS and use signed append-only amendments.

stories.title: Prescription independence, communication provenance and finalization
stories.acceptance: Keep prescriptions optional, preserve incorporated communication, autosave safely, manage incomplete charts and atomically create downstream work.

stories.title: Approved provider, no recording and scoped waiting rooms
stories.acceptance: Certify provider/BAA, disable media capture, issue scoped grants, isolate waiting rooms, support accessible preflight and validate provider events.

stories.title: Realtime reconciliation, reconnect and governed fallback
stories.acceptance: Authorize minimal SignalR, provide polling, preserve encounters through disconnect, deny audio fallback by default and minimize vendor metadata.

stories.title: Idempotent callbacks, communication lifecycle and outage safety
stories.acceptance: Handle duplicate callbacks, retain/incorporate chat safely, exercise outage continuity, block simulator in production and certify compatibility.

stories.title: Prescriber authority and medication safety
stories.acceptance: Authorize prescriber, fail closed for controlled/unknown drugs, require complete safety review and preserve neutral pharmacy choice.

stories.title: Pharmacy identity, lifecycle and SCRIPT mapping
stories.acceptance: Protect proximity search, snapshot pharmacy, separate states, map canonical NCPDP SCRIPT and version signed corrections.

stories.title: Delivery recovery, patient status and production certification
stories.acceptance: Prevent duplicate prescriptions, own rejected/cancel work, communicate accurate AVS status, approve vendors and block uncertified/stub production delivery.

stories.title: Claim-ready signed encounter and governed coding
stories.acceptance: Snapshot source evidence, validate claim fields, derive POS from actual location, govern code rules and separate claim lifecycle states.

stories.title: Human approval, X12 semantics and recovery work
stories.acceptance: Require billing approval, preserve idempotent correction relationships, parse acknowledgments accurately, own failures and prevent pharmacy misrouting.

stories.title: Versioned correction, protected transport and certification
stories.acceptance: Version submitted corrections, protect EDI, exercise robust stub scenarios, gate production trading partners and show accurate patient status.

stories.title: Cohesive feature modules and systems-of-record integration
stories.acceptance: Create bounded modules/application services, reuse legal records, centralize domain commands, isolate adapters and avoid network calls in transactions.

stories.title: Database and distributed-system correctness
stories.acceptance: Enforce constraints, reconciled realtime, horizontal safety, environment separation and a tenant-safe marketplace seam.

stories.title: API/worker/flag and upgrade architecture
stories.acceptance: Use centralized Minimal API conventions, durable workers, audited safe flags and gated framework/provider upgrades.

stories.title: Tenant-safe opaque aggregates and immutable evidence
stories.acceptance: Constrain practice ownership, use opaque IDs/versions, protect published/signed artifacts and retain reconstructable evidence.

stories.title: Separated state, protected payloads and retention
stories.acceptance: Separate domain states, govern object storage and telemetry, execute holds/purge and rehearse additive migrations.

stories.title: Recovery, synthetic data, performance and dictionary
stories.acceptance: Restore aggregate/outbox integrity, isolate production PHI, index target queries and maintain complete data definitions.

stories.title: Versioned Minimal API and server authority contract
stories.acceptance: Document auth/context/validation, enforce semantic idempotency and versions, return safe Problem Details and derive authority server-side.

stories.title: Callback inbox and durable event semantics
stories.acceptance: Validate/persist callbacks, emit minimum immutable events, tolerate delivery disorder, distinguish outcomes and version breaking changes.

stories.title: FHIR/SMART, API protection and safe stubs
stories.acceptance: Validate declared FHIR profiles, layer SMART on resource auth, enforce API limits and isolate synthetic examples/stubs.

stories.title: Risk, production identity and resource authorization foundation
stories.acceptance: Complete governed risk evidence, reject test identity in production, enforce resource/purpose auth, separate roles, prevent PHI leakage and secure sessions.

stories.title: Untrusted content, external boundaries and audit monitoring
stories.acceptance: Protect uploads/payloads, restrict egress/callbacks, prohibit media capture, ensure audit integrity and alert high-risk events.

stories.title: Incident, security testing, consent, support and environment isolation
stories.acceptance: Exercise continuity/breach playbooks, gate security testing, preserve lawful consent, minimize support access and keep production data out of lower environments.

stories.title: WCAG foundation, keyboard semantics and responsive forms
stories.acceptance: Meet WCAG 2.2 AA, keyboard/focus/semantics/reflow/contrast/form recovery and persistent emergency actions.

stories.title: Realtime, video, plain-language state and timeout recovery
stories.acceptance: Make updates assistive-technology safe, support video accessibility, govern content/translation, map exact state and recover identity/timeouts/queues.

stories.title: Consequential actions, notifications, documents and inclusive research
stories.acceptance: Prevent duplicate actions, minimize notifications, produce accessible documents, block PHI analytics, carry accommodations and complete inclusive usability studies.

stories.title: SLO, invariant, capacity and resilience foundation
stories.acceptance: Approve SLOs, alert zero-tolerance invariants, prove capacity/noisy-neighbor behavior, bound retries, define degraded modes and safe telemetry.

stories.title: On-call, health, recovery, deployment and expiry operations
stories.acceptance: Make alerts actionable, separate health, meet DR, deploy compatibly, roll back configs, monitor expiry and present honest outage status.

stories.title: Support, privacy-aware performance and operational readiness
stories.acceptance: Provide safe support correlation, governed segmentation, web/query budgets, signed readiness and multidisciplinary incident review.

stories.title: Requirement, protocol and authorization test gates
stories.acceptance: Trace every requirement, fail CI drift, validate protocol golden cases, cover complete auth, use real PostgreSQL and certify adapters.

stories.title: State, accessibility, security, resilience and production safety tests
stories.acceptance: Replay state/payer packs, test WCAG manually/automatically, attack trust boundaries, exercise production-shaped recovery and reject stubs in production.

stories.title: Content, defect, rehearsal, independent and regression evidence
stories.acceptance: Snapshot accurate content, classify defects, rehearse all E2E cases, independently verify high risks and run shared-platform regressions.

stories.title: Gated development, scoped enablement and safety-first pilot
stories.acceptance: Govern G0/G4, independently enable scopes, prioritize guardrails, bound the pilot and prohibit uncertified live adapters.

stories.title: Protocol/config freshness, metrics and immediate pause
stories.acceptance: Gate protocols, prove configuration freshness, govern metrics, exercise pause criteria and communicate continuity accurately.

stories.title: Evidence-based expansion, marketplace separation and independent review
stories.acceptance: Require expansion evidence, balanced success, separate marketplace approval, expire exceptions and independently review pilot outcomes.
